# runc asks for a terminal for the process because config.json says "terminal": true; a job without a
# controlling terminal cannot give it one. The process needs none: its stdout and stderr go to pipes.
sudo python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import json

path = "/tmp/bench55103653/bundle/config.json"
c = json.load(open(path))
c["process"]["terminal"] = False
json.dump(c, open(path, "w"), indent=2)
PYEOF

sudo python3 - <<'PY'
p = '/tmp/bench55103653/capture_output.py'
s = open(p).read()
old = 'sub_pro = Popen('
new = 'import json\n_c = json.load(open(BUNDLE + "/config.json"))\n_c["process"]["terminal"] = False\njson.dump(_c, open(BUNDLE + "/config.json", "w"))\n\nsub_pro = Popen('
assert old in s
open(p, 'w').write(s.replace(old, new, 1))
PY
